title: Making Sense of Audience Change: Causal Attribution and Boundary Management on Xiaohongshu
abstract: arXiv:2610.38026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recommendation-driven platforms can reshape not only what users see, but also who becomes visible and how community boundaries are negotiated. We examine Xiaohongshu discussions surrounding a perceived World Cup-related audience influx to understand how users attributed community change and how those explanations related to boundary-management strategies. We analyzed 262 comments from eight high-engagement threads using researcher-led thematic analysis, structured coding, and permutation-based association analysis. Users described personalization as both social separation and a boundary that could fail, interpreted platform growth through audience acquisition and commercialization, and contested whether gender should define community membership. Among 70 comments with explicit attributions and strategies, attribution and strategy were strongly associated (Cramer's V = .583): algorithmic attributions concentrated in technical boundary m

translated_title: 理解受众变化：小红书上的因果归因与边界管理
translated_abstract: 推荐算法驱动的平台不仅重塑了用户看到的内容，也改变了谁会变得可见，以及社区边界如何被协商。我们研究了小红书上围绕“世界杯相关受众涌入”这一感知的讨论，以理解用户如何归因社区的变化，以及这些解释与边界管理策略之间的关系。我们采用研究者主导的主题分析、结构化编码和基于置换检验的关联分析方法，对八个高互动帖子中的262条评论进行了分析。用户将个性化推荐既描述为社会隔离，也描述为可能失效的边界；通过受众获取和商业化来解读平台增长；并争论性别是否应当成为界定社区成员资格的标准。在70条包含明确归因和策略的评论中，归因与策略之间存在强关联（Cramer's V = .583）：算法归因集中于技术性边界管理……（摘要内容不完整，此处截至原文截断处）
tldr: 本研究通过分析小红书用户对世界杯期间受众涌入的讨论，首次揭示了用户对社区变化的因果归因（如算法个性化、平台商业化）与其边界管理策略之间存在显著强关联（Cramer's V = .583）。
en_tdlr: By analyzing Xiaohongshu users' discussions of a perceived World Cup-related audience influx, this study reveals a strong association (Cramer's V = .583) between users' causal attributions of community change—such as algorithmic personalization and platform commercialization—and their boundary-management strategies.
